questions.question: Kalamandalam Kshemavathy Pavithran was conferred the Padma Shri award for her contribution to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Kalamandalam Kshemavathy Pavithran is a veteran exponent of Mohiniyattam. Trained at the prestigious Kerala Kalamandalam, she is celebrated for her expressive Abhinaya and her efforts in choreographing new themes within the traditional framework of the 'Dance of the Enchantress'.

questions.question: Which of the following Indian classical Bharatanatyam dancers received the honours of Padma Shri in 1981 and Padma Bhushan in 2003?
questions.solution: Dr. Padma Subrahmanyam is a legendary Bharatanatyam dancer, research scholar, and choreographer. She is famous for developing Bharatanrityam, a style that incorporates the 108 Karanas (classical dance units) described in the Natya Shastra.

questions.question: Which of the following Indian classical singers was known as Mallika-e-Ghazal or the Queen of Ghazal and got appreciations by the Nightingale of India, Sarojini Naidu at the age of fifteen?
questions.solution: Begum Akhtar, also known as Akhtari Bai Faizabadi, was the Mallika-e-Ghazal (Queen of Ghazals). She was a master of Ghazal, Dadra, and Thumri. Her talent was famously recognized by the poet Sarojini Naidu during a performance in Kolkata.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan, Kanak Rele was conferred with the award for her significant contribution to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Dr. Kanak Rele was a pioneering Mohiniyattam dancer and dance educationist. She was the founder-director of the Nalanda Nritya Kala Mahavidyalaya in Mumbai and is credited with the scientific revival and systematization of Mohiniyattam.

questions.question: Who was recognised as ‘Asthana Nartaki’ (resident dancer) of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam?
questions.solution: Yamini Krishnamurthy was bestowed the title of Asthana Nartaki by the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam (TTD). She is an iconic dancer who played a major role in bringing both Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi to national and international prominence.

questions.question: Kelucharan Mohapatra, awarded with Padma Vibhushan in 2000, was a dancer of which of the following dances?
questions.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra is the legendary figure who revived Odissi in the 20th century. He was the first person from Odisha to receive the Padma Vibhushan (2000) and trained generations of world-class dancers.

questions.question: Rama Vaidyanathan was awarded with the honour of the Devadasi National Award in 2013 for her contribution in which of the following Indian dance forms?
questions.solution: Rama Vaidyanathan is a leading contemporary Bharatanatyam artist. She received the Devadasi National Award for her excellence in the field and is known for her innovative choreography that remains deeply rooted in traditional grammar.

questions.question: Who among the following has been awarded the Padma Shri in 2020 for her contribution in Indian Classical dance?
questions.solution: Indira P.P. Bora is a prominent Sattriya and Bharatanatyam dancer from Assam. She was awarded the Padma Shri in 2020 for her tireless work in promoting the Sattriya dance form across India and abroad.

questions.question: The “Sattriya” classical dance is associated with which state?
questions.solution: Sattriya is the classical dance form of Assam. It was introduced in the 15th century by the great saint-reformer Srimanta Sankardev as a medium for propagating the Vaishnava faith through Sattras (monasteries).

questions.question: ____________ is a reputed classical dancer of Kathak dance form.
questions.solution: Shovana Narayan is a highly acclaimed Kathak dancer and a disciple of Pt. Birju Maharaj. She is known for her technical precision and for being an officer of the Indian Audit and Accounts Service while maintaining a stellar dance career.

questions.question: Renowned dancer and actor Minati Mishra was conferred with the Padma Shri for her significant contribution to which of the following Classical Dance forms?
questions.solution: Minati Mishra was an eminent Odissi dancer and actress. She was known for her elegant style and was one of the early pioneers who helped establish the classical status of Odissi outside of Odisha.

questions.question: Of which of the following forms are Kelucharan Mahapatra, Sonal Mansingh and Geeta Mahalik famous dancers?
questions.solution: Kelucharan Mohapatra, Sonal Mansingh, and Geeta Mahalik are all world-renowned exponents of Odissi. Each has played a vital role in the global recognition and preservation of this ancient temple dance from Odisha.

questions.question: T Balasaraswati, a dance legend from India was awarded the Padma Vibhushan for her contribution to Indian art and culture, in which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: T. Balasaraswati was a legendary Bharatanatyam dancer belonging to a family of traditional musicians and dancers. She was a key figure in preserving the Pandanallur style and was the first dancer to receive the Padma Vibhushan.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan awardee, Buddhadev Das Gupta was an Indian classical _________ player.
questions.solution: Buddhadev Dasgupta was a master of the Sarod, representing the Shahjahanpur Gharana. He was awarded the Padma Bhushan for his scholarly approach and technical mastery over the instrument.

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी नृत्य शैली उत्तर भारत से संबंधित है?
questions.solution: Kathak is the only classical dance form of India that originated in North India (primarily Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan). The word is derived from 'Katha', meaning the art of storytelling.

questions.question: It is Elephanta Festival' named after the Elephanta Caves.
questions.solution: The Elephanta Festival is a grand cultural event held annually on the Elephanta Island in Maharashtra. It features classical music and dance performances against the backdrop of the UNESCO World Heritage Elephanta Caves.

questions.question: Shovana Narayan, a Padma Shri awardee, is a dancer of which of the following classical dance forms of India?
questions.solution: Shovana Narayan is one of the most famous names in Kathak. She is a recipient of the Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, and is known for her profound research into the history of the dance.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan awardee Padma Subrahmanyam is a _________ dancer.
questions.solution: Padma Subrahmanyam, a Bharatanatyam legend, is unique for being a dancer, musician, and an indologist. Her work in reconstructing the Marga (ancient) technique of dance has earned her the Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan.

questions.question: Who among the following got the Sangeet Natak Akademi 2017 for her contribution to Odissi dance?
questions.option_1: L N Oinam Ongbi Dhoni Devi
questions.solution: Sujata Mohapatra, the daughter-in-law of Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra, received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2017 for Odissi. She is widely regarded as one of the finest contemporary practitioners of the style.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee Guru Keezhpadam Kumaran Nair was a dancer of which of the following classical dances of India?
questions.solution: Guru Keezhpadam Kumaran Nair was a doyen of Kathakali. He was a master of the Kalluvazhi Chitta (style) and was known for his versatility in playing diverse characters ranging from noble heroes to demonic anti-heroes.

questions.question: Pandit Shambhu Maharaj, a classical __________ dancer, was awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1967.
questions.solution: Pandit Shambhu Maharaj was a leading light of the Lucknow Gharana of Kathak. He was particularly famous for his Thumri Abhinaya, where he would interpret the same line of a song in numerous expressive ways.

questions.question: Who among the following was honoured with the Padma Shri in 2011 for his/her excellence in Chhau, a semi-classical dance form of Eastern India?
questions.solution: Makar Dhwaja Daroga was an eminent exponent of Chhau, a semi-classical/folk dance from Eastern India. He was honored with the Padma Shri in 2011 for his contribution to the Seraikella style of Chhau.

questions.question: Sitara Devi, Padma Shri and Kalidas Samman awardee was awarded for reviving which of the following dance forms in India?
questions.solution: Sitara Devi was a legendary Kathak dancer, once described by Rabindranath Tagore as the 'Nritya Samragini' (Empress of Dance). She was a powerhouse performer of the Banaras Gharana and a key figure in reviving the dance form's popularity.

questions.question: Veteran Dance guru, Jatin Goswami was awarded with the Kalidas Samman for his significant contribution to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Jatin Goswami is a veteran guru of Sattriya dance. He received the Kalidas Samman for his immense contribution to the refinement and global promotion of this Assamese classical tradition.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee Shobha Naidu was a _______ dancer.
questions.solution: Shobha Naidu was an outstanding Kuchipudi dancer and a prime disciple of Vempati Chinna Satyam. She was the principal of the Kuchipudi Art Academy in Hyderabad and was honored with the Padma Shri in 2001.
